people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow. They must wash their clothes
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to day and to morrow, and let them wash their clothes,
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto Moses, Go unto the people, and sanctify them to-day and to-morrow, and let them wash their garments,
